questions.question: If matrix A has dimension 2 × 3 and matrix B has dimension 2 × 2, which of the following statements is true regarding their matrix products?
options: BA is defined, but AB is not defined.
AB is defined, but BA is not defined.
Both AB and BA are defined.
Neither AB nor BA is defined.
questions.answer: BA is defined, but AB is not defined.
